title: GPT Astra 6 model is insane
author: Independent-Arm-7397
selftext:
First game that I created in the shortest time \~ only around 2 hours. I used GPT Astra 6 on Rezona, and I was surprised by the 3D objects and environment, some tips on building:  
  
\- build game mechanism first, have a clear and good game mechanism  
\- Polish the characters and environment later

Anyone wants to try my game, happy to drop it in the comment
